# Continuation2 independent source admission

M78-CONT2-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW-01. Reviewer /root/resume_release. Adapter author /root/resume_recipe; private wrapper and refresh observer authored by root. September22,2026. Accept bounded source preparation, not an actual baseline pass or a fix for the unexplained download mismatch.

## Scope and evidence

Author Candidate1 snapshot39ada02d33bdb283208571594c5c97b8f01c6c5f3c279b23249c79a51fce5c7c verified. Exact failed parent8525a8416b3e55f07d508c9a9ec17fc8ac0a4902e798534dc05e9f4df72d1a46 equals frozen fixture. Parser requires its24 hash-chained events/head e766f74b, failed baseline,0 applicationPOSTs, one matched login and204 logout for each of four roles, unknownAuth0 and all sessions closed. It refuses changed bytes/company or a parent with writes. Original journals are read only.

Adapter invokes the unchanged runM78Continuation through explicit new journal storage. Only the new continuation2 journal, diagnostic journal and exclusive CLI lock are written. Baseline refuses existing outputs; subsequent phases require clean runner history and a passing diagnostics terminal. Failed phases are preserved and not reset/replayed. Inner original harness3ee24, plan c428, migration546 and37-write recipe remain unchanged, as do original timeouts and limits. This authorization concerns a new read-only baseline after a proven zero-write failure; it cannot authorize repeating an unknown application write.

Diagnostic fetch preserves request init/signal and the original unread response object. It records allowlisted route categories, method, bounded content metadata, numeric status/timing and safe error categories; no query, credentials, headers wholesale or response body. No clone/tee/body interception. A failed intent blocks transport except logout. A failed outcome returns the observed token response so original cleanup can close it; subsequent application requests refuse. Bounded8MB/4096-byte diagnostic limits fail closed. Original runner owns authentication, cleanup, gate/restart checks and37-step behavior. Diagnostics cannot explain body mismatch and this review makes no repair claim.

## Source coverage and private entrypoints

Union160 is original admitted155 plus five new roots/evidence files. Independently traversed every relative import reachable from all three new TypeScript roots and checked raw hashes against the union, then verified all155 prior pins. Missing API-route, database, hosted and adapter pins are explicit negative comparisons. No application change or new runtime deployment is claimed; exact commit remains59cda7a62d8dcc6b554c92372e3b032577e410c9.

Private wrapper01e7317590e3e9f287141ecffab4f69d56d7eeca8c683912b8bd437a184bd910 verifies root gate hash, current runtime, independent160-array equality, recomputed source union, original harness/plan/migration, M77 closure and all four evidence pins before DPAPI unseal. Fourth pinned evidence is the failed24 parent. Adapter semantically verifies that parent before invoking the original runner. Actual restart artifact forwarding remains unchanged. Externally admitted exact wrapper/gate bytes remain root's responsibility; source review does not execute PowerShell or decrypt anything.

New refresh observer dd52a4c310bb41fbb9712aaf4796a6263a4d52f0787f995697929526177f7d7b admits baseline/exercise/revisit preflight with fresh nonfuture collection under120seconds, exact deployment0f2e99f3/commit59cda7/imagefe46, successful single live deployment, exactready21 and exclusive new outputs. It is not restart evidence. New offline evaluator executes exact pinned bytes with mocked network and synthetic temporary files.

## Validation and remaining gates

Author tests independently rerun:8 pass/211 assertions. New reviewer tests:3 pass/867 assertions. Strict targeted TypeScript passed. Refresh evaluator:28 matched cases,4positive24negative, including all three valid phases, stale/future collections, coordinated identity substitution, competing live deployment, invalid readiness, reused output and optimized Python refusal. Static wrapper-order tests do not claim actual credential-barrier execution.

Machine receipt m78-continuation2-journey-preparation.json is source_preparation_only. No actual provider/auth/database calls, credentials, official runtime outputs, Git or shared ledger operations. Root owns fresh runtime/evidence admission and actual new baseline; the prior mismatch remains unexplained. Original source155, journals and accepted snapshots are unchanged. Requested inherited compute gpt-6-astra/high; actual settings unobservable.

import {test,expect} from 'bun:test'
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
import {resolve,dirname,relative} from 'node:path'
import {m78Continuation2SourcePins,M78_CONTINUATION2_EVIDENCE_PINS} from '../../tools/staging/m78-continuation2-source-pins'
import {m78Continuation2DiagnosticFetch,verifyM78Continuation2Failure} from '../../tools/staging/check-m78-continuation2'
const sha=(b:string|Uint8Array)=>new Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256').update(b).digest('hex')
test('union covers every transitive relative import of new roots and preserved155; missing runtime pins fail equality',async()=>{const pins=await m78Continuation2SourcePins(),map=new Map(pins.map(p=>[p.path,p.sha256]));expect(pins).toHaveLength(160);const prior=JSON.parse(await readFile('evaluations/research-qa/m78-continuation-journey-preparation-final.json','utf8'));for(const pin of prior.sourcePins)expect(map.get(pin.path)).toBe(pin.sha256);const queue=['tools/staging/check-m78-continuation2.ts','tools/staging/check-m78-continuation2.test.ts','tools/staging/m78-continuation2-source-pins.ts'],seen=new Set<string>();while(queue.length){const p=queue.pop()!;if(seen.has(p))continue;seen.add(p);expect(map.get(p)).toBe(sha(await readFile(p)));const body=await readFile(p,'utf8');for(const m of body.matchAll(/(?:from\s*|import\s*\(\s*|import\s*)['"](\.[^'"]+)['"]/g)){const base=resolve(dirname(p),m[1]!);let found:string|undefined;for(const path of [base,base+'.ts',base+'.tsx',resolve(base,'index.ts')])try{await readFile(path);found=relative('.',path).replaceAll('\\','/');break}catch{}expect(found).toBeDefined();queue.push(found!)}}for(const path of ['apps/site-api/src/workspace/m78-routes.ts','packages/neuvetra-database/src/m78.ts','packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.ts','tools/staging/check-m78-continuation2.ts']){expect(map.has(path)).toBe(true);expect(JSON.stringify(pins.filter(p=>p.path!==path))).not.toBe(JSON.stringify(pins))}})
test('exact parent file equals frozen fixture; wrapper checks four evidence pins and full union before unseal',async()=>{const fixture=await readFile('tools/staging/m78-continuation2-failed-baseline.jsonl','utf8'),actual=await readFile('.superpowers/m78-hosted-continuation.jsonl','utf8');expect(actual).toBe(fixture);expect(verifyM78Continuation2Failure(actual,'8b90c706-1710-494d-b12d-02eef88eacb7')).toHaveLength(24);expect(M78_CONTINUATION2_EVIDENCE_PINS).toHaveLength(4);for(const pin of M78_CONTINUATION2_EVIDENCE_PINS)expect(sha(await readFile(pin.path))).toBe(pin.sha256);const s=await readFile('.superpowers/m78-private-continuation2-journey.ps1','utf8');expect(sha(s)).toBe('01e7317590e3e9f287141ecffab4f69d56d7eeca8c683912b8bd437a184bd910');const unseal=s.indexOf('[Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect');for(const marker of ['m78_independent_continuation2_preparation_passed','complete source closure changed','reviewed closure mismatch','missing original outcome evidence']){expect(s.indexOf(marker)).toBeGreaterThan(0);expect(s.indexOf(marker)).toBeLessThan(unseal)}expect(s).toContain('$review.evidencePins.Count -ne 4');expect(s).toContain('tools/staging/check-m78-continuation2.ts');expect(s).toContain('-NotePropertyName restartAttestation -NotePropertyValue $admission.artifacts.restart')})
test('failed diagnostic intent stops login but permits all cleanup requests even if diagnostic writes keep failing',async()=>{let network=0;const observer=m78Continuation2DiagnosticFetch((async()=>{network++;return new Response(null,{status:204})})as any,async()=>{throw Error('disk failure')});await expect(observer.fetch('https://icockcoguyadhryzydvl.supabase.co/auth/v1/token',{method:'POST'})).rejects.toThrow();expect(network).toBe(0);for(let i=0;i<4;i++)expect((await observer.fetch('https://icockcoguyadhryzydvl.supabase.co/auth/v1/logout',{method:'POST'})).status).toBe(204);expect(network).toBe(4);expect(observer.healthy()).toBe(false);await expect(observer.fetch('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready')).rejects.toThrow();expect(network).toBe(4)})

"""Offline independent tests for the exact M78 fresh runtime preflight helper."""
import copy,hashlib,io,json,os,sys,tempfile,urllib.request,contextlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
source_path=Path('.superpowers/m78-continuation2-refresh-runtime.py').resolve();source=source_path.read_bytes();expected='dd52a4c310bb41fbb9712aaf4796a6263a4d52f0787f995697929526177f7d7b';assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==expected
now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);stamp=lambda seconds:(now+timedelta(seconds=seconds)).isoformat();deployment='0f2e99f3-67ef-4f4c-b3c3-a39c62eabc78';commit='59cda7a62d8dcc6b554c92372e3b032577e410c9';image='sha256:fe46a0e354252026f2bcbf6672e10ec550e52a56f064ab3e75a8af17625749c9';ready={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
base={'status':'m78_runtime_verified','schemaVersion':21,'phase':'deployment','observedAt':stamp(-7200),'deploymentId':deployment,'commit':commit,'imageDigest':image,'deploymentStatus':'SUCCESS','httpStatus':200,'ready':ready};rows=[{'id':deployment,'status':'SUCCESS','meta':{'commitHash':commit,'imageDigest':image}}]
def run(name,change=None,phase='exercise',passing=False,optimize=0):
 b=copy.deepcopy(base);r=copy.deepcopy(rows);response=copy.deepcopy(ready);collection={'observedAt':stamp(-30)};special={'http':200,'existing':False,'bad_hash':False}
 if change:change(b,r,response,collection,special)
 raw=json.dumps(r).encode();collection['sha256']='b'*64 if special['bad_hash']else hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='neuvetra-m78-continuation2-refresh-review-')as directory:
  folder=Path(directory)/'.superpowers';folder.mkdir();(folder/'m78-continuation-final-deployment-verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(b));(folder/'m78-continuation2-refresh-deployments-collection.json').write_text(json.dumps(collection));(folder/'m78-continuation2-refresh-deployments.json').write_bytes(raw);output=folder/('m78-continuation2-'+phase+'-runtime-verified.json')
  if special['existing']:output.write_text('retained')
  def network(url,timeout):
   assert url=='https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready'and timeout==30
   stream=io.BytesIO(json.dumps(response).encode());stream.status=special['http'];return stream
  cwd=os.getcwd();argv=sys.argv;urlopen=urllib.request.urlopen;ok=False;error=None
  try:
   os.chdir(directory);sys.argv=['refresh',phase];urllib.request.urlopen=network
   try:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):exec(compile(source,str(source_path),'exec',optimize=optimize),{'__name__':'__main__'})
    ok=True
   except Exception as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
  finally:urllib.request.urlopen=urlopen;sys.argv=argv;os.chdir(cwd)
  assert ok==passing,(name,ok,error)
  if passing:
   result=json.loads(output.read_text());assert result['phase']==phase+'_preflight'and result['status']=='m78_runtime_verified'and result['ready']==ready and result['deploymentCollection']==collection;assert 'actualStartupEvent'not in result and 'restartAcknowledged'not in result
  elif special['existing']:assert output.read_text()=='retained'
  else:assert not output.exists(),name
  return {'case':name,'accepted':ok,'expectedAccepted':passing,'errorCategory':error}
cases=[run('valid_baseline',phase='baseline',passing=True),run('valid_exercise',passing=True),run('valid_revisit_is_preflight_only',phase='revisit',passing=True)]
def add(name,fn,**kwargs):cases.append(run(name,fn,**kwargs))
add('stale_collection',lambda b,r,s,c,x:c.update(observedAt=stamp(-121)))
add('future_collection',lambda b,r,s,c,x:c.update(observedAt=stamp(30)))
add('wrong_raw_hash',lambda b,r,s,c,x:x.update(bad_hash=True))
add('wrong_deployment',lambda b,r,s,c,x:r[0].update(id='other'))
add('coordinated_wrong_deployment',lambda b,r,s,c,x:(r[0].update(id='other'),b.update(deploymentId='other')))
add('wrong_status',lambda b,r,s,c,x:r[0].update(status='BUILDING'))
add('wrong_commit',lambda b,r,s,c,x:r[0]['meta'].update(commitHash='a'*40))
add('coordinated_wrong_commit',lambda b,r,s,c,x:(r[0]['meta'].update(commitHash='a'*40),b.update(commit='a'*40)))
add('wrong_image',lambda b,r,s,c,x:r[0]['meta'].update(imageDigest='sha256:'+'a'*64))
add('coordinated_wrong_image',lambda b,r,s,c,x:(r[0]['meta'].update(imageDigest='sha256:'+'a'*64),b.update(imageDigest='sha256:'+'a'*64)))
for status in ['SUCCESS','BUILDING','DEPLOYING','WAITING']:add('other_live_'+status,lambda b,r,s,c,x,st=status:r.append({'id':'other','status':st}))
add('old_terminal_deployments_allowed',lambda b,r,s,c,x:r.extend([{'id':'old-'+st,'status':st}for st in ['REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED']]),passing=True)
add('http_503',lambda b,r,s,c,x:x.update(http=503))
for key,value in [('status','starting'),('profile','public'),('schemaVersion',20),('legacyContainmentVerified',False)]:add('wrong_readiness_'+key,lambda b,r,s,c,x,k=key,v=value:s.update({k:v}))
add('coordinated_wrong_readiness',lambda b,r,s,c,x:(s.update(schemaVersion=20),b['ready'].update(schemaVersion=20)))
add('extra_readiness_field',lambda b,r,s,c,x:s.update(extra=True))
add('exclusive_output',lambda b,r,s,c,x:x.update(existing=True))
cases.append(run('invalid_phase',phase='restart'));cases.append(run('optimized_python_refused',optimize=1))
result={'status':'m78_independent_runtime_refresh_source_passed','createdAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reviewerId':'/root/resume_release','helperSha256':expected,'caseCount':len(cases),'positiveCases':sum(x['accepted']for x in cases),'cases':cases,'networkMocked':True,'hostedCalls':0,'officialOutputWrites':0,'actualDeploymentOrRestartVerified':False}
Path('evaluations/research-qa/m78-continuation2-runtime-refresh-independent-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='cases'}))

import json,sys,urllib.request,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
if not __debug__: raise RuntimeError('Optimized execution forbidden')
phase=sys.argv[1]
assert phase in ('baseline','exercise','revisit')
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
base=read('.superpowers/m78-continuation-final-deployment-verified.json')
collection=read('.superpowers/m78-continuation2-refresh-deployments-collection.json')
raw=Path('.superpowers/m78-continuation2-refresh-deployments.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==collection['sha256']
assert 0 <= (now-datetime.fromisoformat(collection['observedAt'])).total_seconds() < 120
rows=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig'))
row=next(r for r in rows if r['id']==base['deploymentId'])
assert row['id']=='0f2e99f3-67ef-4f4c-b3c3-a39c62eabc78' and row['status']=='SUCCESS'
assert row['meta']['commitHash']==base['commit']=='59cda7a62d8dcc6b554c92372e3b032577e410c9'
assert row['meta']['imageDigest']==base['imageDigest']=='sha256:fe46a0e354252026f2bcbf6672e10ec550e52a56f064ab3e75a8af17625749c9'
assert not any(r['id']!=row['id'] and r['status'] not in ('REMOVED','FAILED','CRASHED','SKIPPED') for r in rows)
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.neuvetra.ai/ready',timeout=30) as response:
 assert response.status==200
 ready=json.load(response)
assert ready==base['ready']=={'status':'ready','profile':'neuvetra.private-synthetic-staging.v1','schemaVersion':21,'legacyContainmentVerified':True}
result={**base,'phase':phase+'_preflight','observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'deploymentCollection':collection,'ready':ready}
with Path('.superpowers/m78-continuation2-'+phase+'-runtime-verified.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
